args.query: weekly retail gasoline price national average

sql: SELECT report_date, price_dollars_per_gallon FROM energy.eia_retail_gasoline_prices WHERE series_id='EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG' AND report_date >= '2026-02-01' ORDER BY report_date

SELECT a.price_year, a.p0, b.p1, b.p1 - a.p0 AS chg FROM (SELECT price_year, MAX(CASE WHEN report_date >= concat(cast(price_year as varchar),'-10-01') AND report_date < concat(cast(price_year as varchar),'-10-08') THEN price_dollars_per_gallon END) p0 FROM energy.eia_retail_gasoline_prices WHERE series_id='EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG' GROUP BY price_year) a JOIN (SELECT price_year, MAX(CASE WHEN report_date >= concat(cast(price_year as varchar),'-11-01') AND report_date < concat(cast(price_year as varchar),'-11-08') THEN price_dollars_per_gallon END) p1 FROM energy.eia_retail_gasoline_prices WHERE series_id='EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG' GROUP BY price_year) b ON a.price_year=b.price_year WHERE a.price_year>=2006 ORDER BY 1

SELECT report_date, price_dollars_per_gallon FROM energy.eia_retail_gasoline_prices WHERE series_id='EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG' AND ((report_date BETWEEN '2022-10-03' AND '2022-11-14') OR (report_date BETWEEN '2010-09-27' AND '2010-11-08') OR (report_date BETWEEN '2024-09-30' AND '2024-11-11')) ORDER BY report_date
SELECT date, value FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='DCOILWTICO' AND date BETWEEN '2026-10-26' AND '2026-11-20' ORDER BY date
